description:
Ask Ultrapedia to research a race again. Use it when something looks out of
date, wrong or missing and you do not have a page and quote for
`propose_correction`. `issue` is `outdated` (the date, price or start time is of
a past edition, or the race has changed), `incorrect` (a value looks wrong) or
`missing` (the race publishes values that are empty here). `fields` is a list of
the column names you mean; leave it out for the race-day values. `note` says
what you saw. This changes no value: a research agent checks the race's own
site, usually within a few days, and the races asked for most are done first.
name: request_update
title: Ask for an update
